purpose: Confirmatory Claude Sonnet 5 protocol comparison on every candidate untouched by the aborted v1 operational run.

selection.rule: retain every structurally eligible candidate in candidate-manifest order except tasks with agent output after candidate lock; never inspect candidate reward or tool behavior to select confirmatory tasks

arms.cli: Sourcegraph CLI required before local repository inspection; local repositories readable after first CLI call

cache_isolation.scope: fresh random scope generated independently for every invocation
cache_isolation.comparison_rule: valid proof and cross_run_cache_read_tokens == 0 and cache_write_tokens == 0

execution_configuration.order_policy: candidate-manifest order; rotate baseline,mcp_only,cli as a three-row Latin square by task index; execute sequentially on agent account 3; judge every completed slot on account 1

spend_guard.forecast_basis: No v2 spend authorization before a strengthened-CLI operational canary passes.

evidence_policy.historical_pilots: operational evidence only; never headline evidence
evidence_policy.forced_code_finder: separate descriptive study; never headline evidence
evidence_policy.codex_opencode: secondary harness-model bundles; never causal cross-model evidence
evidence_policy.invalid_slot: stop promotion; retain receipt and all-attempt spend
evidence_policy.image_identity: record immutable built image and bound container digests per trial
